title: The Rivian Electric Amazon Delivery Van Is Highly Innovative and Incredibly Cool
summary: Doug DeMuro reviews the Rivian electric delivery van built for Amazon, walking through its quirks, features and design innovations. It is a long, detailed tour of the vehicle inside and out.
why: HN points to it as the most thorough walkthrough of the Amazon Rivian van, useful for seeing its real size and delivery-specific design.

quote.text: This is a thorough tour, and I want one
